Principle 6: My School Teacher
Today, I would like to tell you about my school.
My school is pretty close to my house.
My elementary school is fairly large. My brother goes to the same school.
There are many clubs that the students can join.
I attend the English Club,
and my brother is in the Tai-Kweon-Do(태권도) Club.
I would like to introduce my teacher. My teacher’s name is Mr. 홍.
He is about 30 years old. He loves children and makes learning fun.
Sometimes, he tells us great stories. He is a good teacher.
My teacher is from Kang-won province.
Sometimes, He speaks with a funny accent!
He is tall. His hair is black.
He has a habit of touching his nose, biting his nails, scratching his nails,
cracking his knuckles, rubbing his eyes, etc.) when he teaches.
I think he likes the color blue because he always wears a blue tie.
He is very kind, and I like him a lot.
My teacher is helping me realize my dreams.
My teacher also always tells us to set goals in order to reach our dreams.
He helps us.
He tells us that we must read a lot of books.
He is very kind to each student and points out our good qualities.
He helps us to develop our talents.
My teacher always says that I should be a teacher
because of my good qualities.
So now I want to become a teacher.
